status: Exploratory composition challenge specified after reviewing prior results and source metadata, before calculating these between-compartment mixture outcomes; not independently preregistered.
question: Can between-compartment captured-RNA composition contribute to the opposing bulk versus fibroblast age directions without changing any fixed genes?
coverage_gate: Use source annotated-cell-set membership to require at most one selected compartment per label. Audit every label and donor against the original selected captured-cell counts. Missing excluded-label UMIs force partial-mixture status even if captured-cell coverage is high.
reference_weight_rule: For each of the 13 healthy inferred donors with all nine compartments present and positive total UMIs, divide each compartment UMI total by that donor's included-compartment UMI total. Common RNA weights are the unweighted average of those 13 donor-specific fractions. Do not pool donor counts, use age labels to optimize weights, include disease donors, or use selected-gene values.
sparse_compartment_policy: Primary keeps all 13 healthy donors, including 9-19-cell minor compartments; record their counts. Sensitivity restricts to donors with at least 20 captured cells in every included compartment, keeping the same frozen weights. This metadata-defined subset has eight healthy donors and a different age distribution.
score_rule: For each donor and gene, mix compartment CPM using observed or common RNA weights before log1p, then average unchanged panel genes. Observed-mixture gene CPM must equal summed included counts / summed included total UMIs * 1e6 to 1e-8 absolute tolerance. Never weight log scores or substitute cell fractions for RNA fractions.
panels: Exactly the six existing fixed panels in the pinned coverage table; no gene reselection or alias changes.
model_rule: OLS with intercept and centered age in decades; include male and/or Cell Ranger 3.0.1 indicator only when named; require two residual degrees of freedom and full rank. Restrict to healthy donors and preserve failures. Every score type uses identical donors within each model.
omission_weight_rule: Omit each donor only from the age fit, with the same previously frozen common composition reference. That donor contributed to reference weights: these are influence diagnostics, not donor-held-out validation.

direction_comparisons.previous_cell: Use pinned GSE164241 combined-fibroblast/epithelium slopes as context, not independent replication.
direction_comparisons.previous_bulk: Compare signs only with GSE173078 female+batch and GSE83382 bulk findings. Do not pool numerical scales or people, or assert full-tissue equivalence.

limits: Selected groups cover 85,752 of 86,138 captured cells; omitted cell-cycle/melanocyte/Schwann/Merkel labels lack retained raw pseudobulk. Their UMI contribution is unknown.
Captured single-cell RNA fractions are affected by dissociation, capture, annotation and sequencing; they are not measured intact-tissue cell/RNA fractions.
Common-composition standardization is an algebraic observational sensitivity, not a causal intervention or reconstruction of whole gingiva.
The same inferred donors and correlated panels are reused. No biological age clock, training, donor-independent validation or rejuvenation claim.
Cell mixture cannot be separated from all cohort, tissue-site, age-range, health and assay differences between studies.
